slides.title: Email is down at the roofing office. New holiday. Rules:
No general contractor can send "URGENT: updated COI needed before crew starts."
slides.body: They will call instead. Let it ring.

slides.title: Renewal notices can't get lost in your inbox today.
slides.body: They're lost somewhere else. Probably the truck.

slides.title: You finally open the paper mail.
slides.body: The contractor license renewal reminder was in there. Since October.

slides.title: You check the crew's certifications against the wall calendar.
slides.body: Suspiciously productive. Nobody can ask you anything.

slides.label: 2:14 PM
slides.title: Email comes back.
slides.body: So does the COI request. Plus four more.
